biocontainers.name: bioconductor-scds
biocontainers.summary: In-silico annotation of doublets for single cell rna sequencing data

biotools.summary: In single cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data combinations of cells are sometimes considered a single cell (doublets). The scds package provides methods to annotate doublets in scRNA-seq data computationally.
